issue.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
When using custom components like ReactSelect it is required to be able to push the initial value of the control into form state without dirtying the form.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Something along the lines of https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/commit/9c50dd9567d3866bfb483bfde507230a415be792 would be fine. 

The third arg to setValue probably should be an option bag to avoid breaking the interface every time a new param is added.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
We could also set the initial value during register.

**Additional context**

see also https://github.com/react-hook-form/react-hook-form/issues/72 which added setDirty to setValue.

body:
> Let's say in the use case I fetch data from a server, and then I set that data as the default value of a field. In this case, defaultValue doesn't work because I don't have data before calling the API so I have to use setValue to manually change the value of the field. Using value instead of defaultValue is out of the question as controlled components are not optimal.

can you use `reset({})`?

Thanks for the response. However, I think `reset` will clear the value of all fields, which is not my intention. Besides, even if I can still retain the value of each field after calling `reset`, `formState.dirty` will still have its value transition from 'false' -> 'true' -> 'false'. This might cause some strange behaviors on UX if I rely on `dirty` to show or hide other components.
